title: Swingers Music From the Miramax Motion Picture CD Soundtrack Dean Martin
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Swingers - Music From The Miramax Motion Picture
(Hollywood Records MH-62091-2, 1996).

Features Dean Martin, Love Jones, Count Basie and Tony Bennett,
Big Bad Voodoo Daddy, Louis Jordan, King Floyd, Joey Altruda,
Roger Miller, The Jazz Jury, George Jones and Average White Band.

See the photographed back insert for the full track listing.

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
